items.title: Former GIB AM managers launch emerging markets boutique Zorza Capital
items.summary: Kunal Desai and Marcin Lewczuk have launched a new emerging markets investment management firm backed by EdgePoint seed capital.

items.title: Risilience estimates 2027 El Niño heatwave impact on global facilities
items.summary: Research from UK analytics firm Risilience indicates that extreme heatwaves could cost global facilities $265bn in lost revenue.

items.title: Charles Taylor Assistance appoints deputy chief medical officer
items.summary: Dr Louise McDevitt joins Charles Taylor Assistance to support growing demand for medical repatriation and travel insurance services.

items.title: Markel Insurance appoints Chloe Gordge to London Market PV&T role
items.summary: Markel Insurance has appointed Chloe Gordge as director of war and political violence and terrorism within its London Market operations.

items.title: Ariel Green appoints Dr Brentan Alexander as Senior Advisor
items.summary: Ariel Green has appointed technology performance insurance specialist Dr Brentan Alexander as Senior Advisor to support its clean energy underwriting capabilities.

items.title: Brokers urged to settle cyber incident response protocols at policy inception
items.summary: Cyber insurance brokers must clarify incident notification pathways and excess-free windows with clients before policies commence to avoid mid-attack friction.
